text.arabic_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: consequential connector that launches the command as the result of prior evidence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the command arrive as a conclusion, not as a fresh detached opening. It gathers the prior signs and destruction scenes into the imperative that follows, while its written attachment to the next word makes inference and command visible as one surface movement.

topics.headline: prior evidence becomes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by converting the preceding evidence into an immediate obligation.
topics.reason: QAC marks consequential sequence, and the clause evidence makes the following imperative the new command unit governed by that consequence.

topics.headline: visible pivot into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the discourse pivot from narrated evidence into a directly addressed command with the connector fused to the action.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic on the command and the boundary rows coherently describe a shift from prior narrative and declaration into direct imperative address.

words.gloss_range: plural imperative to flee, locally completed by a goal rather than an expressed source
words.root_gloss_range: flight, escape, urgent separation, and several distant lexical branches; the local Form I command selects flight and refuge-seeking, not unrelated branches
words.prose: {{ar:فِرُّوٓا۟}} ({{tr:firrū}}) is a plural command, so the ayah does not merely describe fear or private escape; it summons the addressed group into motion. The unusual force is that flight is completed by {{ar:إِلَى ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:ilā Allāhi}}): the danger-register of fleeing remains, but the vector is refuge toward God. Because this is the sole command-form occurrence of this root in the supplied profile, the directive feels concentrated rather than routine. Its crisis field can be heard against the open escape question (75:10), rejection-flight (71:6), and terror-flight (18:18), while the doubled consonant and long plural ending make the urgency audible.

topics.headline: collective command force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word commands the whole addressed group to act, not simply to contemplate or admire the prior signs.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a Form I active 2mp imperative with pro-dropped addressees, preserving command force and collective address.

topics.headline: flight aimed toward refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reversal: a verb of escape is not left open or aimed away from God, but is directed toward Him as refuge.
topics.reason: The directional complement is syntactically forced, and the local frame has no object or expressed source, so the positive surviving payoff is refuge-directed flight.

topics.headline: rare crisis vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command uses a sparse crisis-register root and, in this profile, its only imperative slot.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact Form I command as low occurrence with one frame, supporting the row family's rarity claim without activating unrelated V4 branches.

topics.headline: escape scenes redirected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears other Quranic escape scenes as contrastive background: the open question of escape (75:10), rejection-flight (71:6), and terror-flight (18:18) are answered here by commanded motion toward God.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references, and nothing in the local grammar contradicts using them as contrastive field evidence rather than as the local parse.

topics.headline: compressed sound releases into plural command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice the audible compression of the doubled consonant and its release into the long plural ending as part of the command's urgency.
topics.reason: The surface form supports the phonetic observation, and it reinforces rather than replaces the grammatical imperative force.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the goal of the flight
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) is the small word that gives the flight a destination. It governs {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), so the motion is not random escape; it is goal-directed refuge. Its later contrast with the source-preposition makes the ayah move in two directions at once: the audience goes to God while warning comes from Him. As the goal phrase closes the first beat, the preposition and its governed name cohere as one heard destination before the credential begins.

topics.headline: flight receives its endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command's force is resolved by a destination, not left as panic without direction.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically forced as the directional complement governing the divine name after the flight verb.

topics.headline: direction pairs with source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's circuit: motion is toward God, while the warning later comes from Him.
topics.reason: The local syntax has a goal phrase in the first beat and a source phrase in the second, allowing the polarity payoff without changing either attachment.

topics.headline: preposition and goal cohere audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and see the preposition as part of a completed destination phrase before the credential clause begins.
topics.reason: The recitation liaison and first-beat closure both support treating the preposition and governed name as one goal unit.

words.gloss_range: the definite divine proper name as the goal of commanded flight and antecedent of the later source pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship, deity, awe, and debated refuge-related derivational pressure; local grammar selects the proper divine name as endpoint

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: directional preposition governing the divine name
from Him, with the pronoun referring back to God

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is not a generic refuge-word; it is the definite divine name governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}). That makes God the named endpoint of the flight and then, through {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}), the source of the warning. The debated root-family pressure can enrich the sense of awe and refuge, but local grammar keeps the word functioning as the proper name that anchors both destination and authority. The first beat lands on this name, and 51:51 turns the positive destination into an exclusivity boundary while the warning and clarity fields continue around the same divine referent.

topics.headline: proper name as endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is the named God, not an abstract refuge or any protective power.
topics.reason: The word is a definite proper noun in the genitive governed by the directional preposition, so it supplies the unique goal of the imperative.

topics.headline: awe and refuge pressure within proper-name limits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel that fleeing to God is not bare spatial movement: the named endpoint carries worship, awe, and refuge pressure.
topics.reason: The derivational claims are plausible as root-family pressure, but V4 has no local guardrail rows for this root and QAC selects the proper name, so the topic is kept as coloring rather than a competing lexical sense.

topics.headline: destination returns as source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the same referent receives the commanded flight and sends the warning, closing the ayah's response circuit.
topics.reason: The suffix in the source phrase resolves back to the divine name, so the command beat and credential beat are joined by one referent.

topics.headline: destination anticipates next command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive destination in 51:50 becomes the exclusivity boundary of the following command in 51:51.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete nearby references, and the immediate repetition of the warning formula in 51:51 supports a local command-refrain link.

topics.headline: divine name joins warning and clarity fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the divine name is not isolated from the closing credential; it is tied to warning-source and clarification fields.
topics.reason: Corpus pairings cohere with the local syntax in which God is the destination and the pronominal source of the warning, while 51:51 supplies immediate formulaic reinforcement.

topics.headline: goal phrase lands the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first beat lands on the divine name as a coherent destination phrase.
topics.reason: The divine name closes the command beat and is joined in recitation to its preposition, supporting the placement and audible-continuity payoff.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus first-person suffix launching the speaker's credential clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) turns the ayah from command into asserted speaker credential. The emphatic particle and first-person suffix arrive in one word, so the warrant for the command is not impersonal: a present speaker says that his warning role is stable, sourced, and relevant to the audience. This shift from the audience's commanded action to the speaker's identity begins the credential beat, whose recurring nasal sounds help hold source, warning, and clarification together.

topics.headline: asserted warning identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning role is asserted as a stable credential, not presented as a passing act of warning.
topics.reason: The particle governs the nominal clause and the predicate evidence identifies the warning noun as the central credential.

topics.headline: personal voice carries sourced warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears cosmic evidence become personally voiced warning without confusing the speaker with the divine source.
topics.reason: The first-person suffix marks the current speaker, while the later source pronoun remains distinct and refers to God.

topics.headline: command gives way to credential beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural shift from the audience's commanded action to the speaker's stated authority, held together by the sound pattern of the credential beat.
topics.reason: The clause boundary begins at this word after the imperative beat, and the surface sequence supports the described acoustic link through the remaining credential.

words.gloss_range: for you, to you, designated for the plural audience as warning beneficiaries

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: from Him, the source phrase paired with the recipient phrase

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) keeps the warning on the audience's side: for them, to them, and assigned to their situation. Its suffix carries forward the same plural addressees commanded to flee, and its placement before the warning noun means the recipient-benefit is heard before the role lands. Paired with {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}), it helps map the warning as from God, through the speaker, for the audience, with the adjacent m-sound lightly binding recipient and source.

topics.headline: warning is for the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is framed as beneficially addressed to the audience, not as hostility against them.
topics.reason: The lām phrase is attached as an addressee complement of the warning noun, supporting benefactive and dative payoff.

topics.headline: same group receives command and warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same plural audience from reflection and command into the warning credential.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix matches the command's addressees, so the warning remains directed to the same audience.

topics.headline: recipient and source precede the warner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the credential clause build its route before naming the role: audience-recipient and divine-source are placed before the warner noun.
topics.reason: Both prepositional phrases are attached to the warning predicate, and their sequence supports the communication-vector reading.

words.gloss_range: from Him, source phrase referring back to God as origin of the warning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: God, the antecedent of the source pronoun
for you, the recipient phrase paired with the source phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) marks the warning's origin, with its pronoun pointing back to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}). This keeps the speaker from sounding self-authorizing: the warning comes from God. Together with {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}), the phrase sets the route before the warning noun appears: from Him, for you, through the voiced warner. Source is the selected role, while related belonging and causal pressure stay subordinate to that local attachment.

topics.headline: warning comes from God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is sourced in God, not generated independently by the speaker.
topics.reason: The source preposition attaches to the warning predicate and the suffix resolves to the divine name from the command beat.

topics.headline: source leads while related pressures remain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can retain the sense that the warning proceeds from and belongs to God's authority while source remains the selected local role.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL range is coherent, but local attachment most strongly selects source; partitive and causal pressure are kept only as qualified support.

topics.headline: destination and source close the circuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as a closed circuit: the audience flees to God, and the warning reaches them from Him.
topics.reason: The goal phrase and source phrase refer to the same divine referent while assigning opposite directions in the two beats.

topics.headline: source is heard before role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine source is compacted into one word and heard before the warner role it authorizes.
topics.reason: The fused source-pronoun form and pre-predicate placement both support the row family's structural and sound payoff.

words.gloss_range: a warner, the nominative predicate of the emphatic first-person clause
words.root_gloss_range: warning that awakens caution, with related vow and obligation branches; local predicate selects warning-agent sense while retaining solemn future-binding pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: clear or clarifying, qualifying the warner
for you, from Him, the recipient and source phrases leading into the warner noun

words.prose: {{ar:نَذِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) is the predicate that names the speaker's role: a warner for the audience and from God. The word makes the opening flight command an advance-danger response, while its faʿīl pattern and indefiniteness present warning as a stable role rather than a one-time act. The related vow branch does not replace the local sense, but it keeps the warning solemn and future-binding. With {{ar:مُّبِينٌۭ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}), the role enters a recurring prophetic formula that is immediately repeated in 51:51; here the warning half is foregrounded without an explicit good-news counterpart, and the shared cadence binds warning and clarification into one credential.

topics.headline: warner role anchors the credential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is warranted by an identified warning role, not by an anonymous alarm.
topics.reason: The noun is the nominative predicate of the emphatic clause, and the local lexical branch selects warning about danger.

topics.headline: stable active role with passive pressure limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speaker classified by a stable warning identity, while any passive undertone remains secondary.
topics.reason: The predicate environment and local role evidence select the active warner sense; the passive possibility survives only as pressure, not as the controlling parse.

topics.headline: warning is solemn future speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the warning as a binding future-facing declaration, while the local word remains a warner rather than a vow.
topics.reason: V4 confirms both warning and vow branches, but local grammar selects the warning-agent branch; the vow branch contributes solemn future-binding pressure only.

topics.headline: for-you and from-Him converge on the warner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warner as the meeting point of audience benefit and divine source.
topics.reason: Both prepositional phrases attach inside the predicate environment of the warning noun, giving the role its recipient and source.

topics.headline: recognized prophetic warning formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing phrase as a prophetic self-identification formula that also seals both 51:50 and 51:51.
topics.reason: The rows provide multiple concrete formula references and the immediate recurrence in 51:51, while local syntax gives the formula its role in this command.

topics.headline: warning half is foregrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this ayah foregrounds warning rather than balancing it with an explicit good-news counterpart.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence background is valid as contrast, and the local phrase names the warning role without an explicit good-news term.

topics.headline: audible pairing with the qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears warning and clarification bound together as one paired credential before separating role from qualifier.
topics.reason: Agreement attaches the qualifier to the warning noun, and the shared indefinite cadence supports the audible-pairing payoff.

words.gloss_range: clarifying or clear, Form IV active participle closing and qualifying the warning credential
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, appearance, and clarification; local Form IV active participle selects making clear while the separation image supports distinction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: warner, the noun qualified or paired with the clarifying participle

words.prose: {{ar:مُّبِينٌۭ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) closes the ayah by making clarification active, not merely decorative. It agrees with {{ar:نَذِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) as a qualifier and can also carry second-predicate weight, so the credential is warning plus manifest clarification. The root's separation image sharpens the payoff: the warning makes a distinction between danger and refuge. As a signature Quranic clarity qualifier, it authorizes the immediate command while extending into continuing prophetic address. In final position, with matching cadence, the word turns closure into a refrain that returns in 51:51 and links back to clear authority in 51:38.

topics.headline: clarification belongs inside the credential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarification is grammatically tied to the speaker's credential, whether heard as modifier or as a second predicate.
topics.reason: Agreement strongly licenses adjectival attachment, while the nominative predicate frame also allows the second-predicate payoff without breaking local syntax.

topics.headline: the warner makes things clear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warning as an act of making the matter manifest, not as an obscure threat or passive clearness.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV active participle, and V4 supports the appearance and making-clear branch as locally coherent.

topics.headline: clarity as distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can picture clarity as separation: the warning distinguishes what must be fled from the refuge toward which one flees.
topics.reason: The root includes separation and clarity branches, but the local participle selects active clarification; separation remains an image that explains how clarity works.

topics.headline: signature Quranic qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final qualifier is a broad Quranic clarity term, not a rare private description.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows many active-participle uses and dominant adjective behavior, supporting a recognized qualifier without overclaiming every branch locally.

topics.headline: prophetic formula and local authentication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word as part of a recurring prophetic formula, linked locally to clear authority in 51:38 and repeated warning in 51:51.
topics.reason: The root-pair and recurrence rows cohere with local attachment to the warning noun and with the immediate same-surah repetition in 51:51.

topics.headline: clarity is the ayah's landing point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens with compelled movement and lands on manifest clarification, with cadence binding the final credential.
topics.reason: The word is final, agrees with the warning noun, and shares cadence with it, so the closure and ring payoff survive as local structure.

topics.headline: clear warning exceeds one imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing credential authorize the immediate command while also extending into the continuing prophetic address.
topics.reason: The final participle completes the credential architecture and is repeated in the next ayah, so it functions as more than a local decorative adjective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ففروا, its goal phrase إلى الله, and the speaker's نذير مبين.
baseline_models.mechanism: A danger-report awakens caution, but the goal phrase prevents flight from becoming aimless withdrawal: the commanded motion transfers direction and dependence toward the worshiped One, while disclosure makes the danger and route intelligible.

activation_trace.role: Escape and flight supply the imperative's kinetic departure and the model's transfer of position.
Worship and the worshiped One supply the stated destination and recast motion as transferred allegiance.
Warning of what is feared supplies the alarm that awakens caution and makes departure urgent.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies an intelligible route rather than an unexplained panic.

changed_reading.before: Run away from an unspecified danger because a clear warner says so.
changed_reading.after: Transfer direction and dependence toward Allah; the warning both generates caution and discloses why this is the viable destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion from ففروا إلى and the separating and interval-bearing possibilities of مبين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clear warning does more than explain content. It marks a separation between the hearer's present attachment and the named destination, so flight becomes a boundary crossing through a disclosed interval.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the act that crosses out of the hearer's present position.
The worshiped One supplies the far side of the boundary as a positive destination.
Warning supplies the threshold signal that demands a choice before danger arrives.
Separation after connection supplies the boundary that the commanded flight enacts.
The interval between two sides supplies spatial thickness to the move from present location to stated goal.

changed_reading.before: The adjective مبين says only that the warner is easy to understand.
changed_reading.after: The warning makes a decisive boundary visible, and ففروا commands the hearer to cross it toward Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses arrives with manifest, compelling warrant, but Pharaoh turns away while leaning on his strong side. Against that scene, the focus imperative reverses both vector and support: leave the posture that turns with a worldly الركن and move toward Allah.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the voluntary counter-motion to Pharaoh's refusal.
The worshiped One supplies the replacement support and destination.
Compelling proof supplies warranted grounds for movement rather than unreasoning fear.
Manifest disclosure makes the earlier authority parallel the focus warning in clarity.
Turning away supplies the rejected directional response that the focus imperative reverses.
A strong side leaned upon supplies the rival support from which dependence is transferred.

structural_cues: 51:38 and 51:50 both pair a directional إلى phrase with a form of manifest clarity.
The ف-initial turning of 51:39 and ف-initial flight of 51:50 present opposed responses to disclosed warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compelling clarity, Pharaoh's turning, and his leaned-on support; I infer a vector reversal from that reliance toward Allah. A live alternative is that the history supplies only a punishment example and no deliberate directional contrast.

changed_reading.before: Flee toward divine safety in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Reverse Pharaoh's movement: stop turning away while leaning on coercive support, and transfer reliance toward Allah on the basis of disclosed warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's party does not choose its final movement: seizure is followed by being thrown into the great water. The focus command preserves the remaining alternative, voluntary self-displacement toward a named destination before agency is replaced by capture and forced displacement.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies voluntary motion while the addressee can still choose.
The worshiped One supplies the chosen goal that distinguishes directed flight from mere ejection.
Capture and confinement supply the loss of self-directed agency.
Throwing away supplies involuntary displacement as the negative counterpart to commanded flight.
The great water supplies the imposed terminal destination of the captured movement.

structural_cues: The chained ف verbs in 51:40 compress seizure and throwing into an irreversible sequence.
The focus also begins with ف, but gives the audience an imperative and an explicit goal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, throwing, and a terminal location; I infer that the focus contrasts chosen direction with later imposed movement. A live alternative is that the sea episode intensifies danger without specifying a theory of agency.

changed_reading.after: Choose your destination toward Allah while choice remains, before judgment turns movement into capture and ejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sterile wind reaches every encountered thing, leaves nothing, and converts it to decay. That totalized material field removes the easy reading of flight as relocation to another worldly shelter; the distinctive force lies in the non-lateral destination, إلى الله.

activation_trace.role: Escape supplies the motion whose possible kind is revised by the context's total reach.
The worshiped One supplies a destination not reducible to another object inside the devastated field.
Wind and moving air supply the destructive medium that traverses locations.
The sterile wind supplies a force that produces no sheltering or fruitful remainder.
Leaving a thing behind, under negation, supplies the claim that no material remainder escapes.
The arrival of calamity supplies the wind's reaching relation to whatever lies in its path.
Transformation into a state supplies the irreversible material conversion.
Decay and worn remains supply the terminal state that ordinary relocation cannot evade.

structural_cues: The ما...من شيء...إلا construction in 51:42 totalizes the wind's reach and result.
The focus names a destination rather than naming a safer terrestrial place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an all-reaching destructive medium and conversion to decay; I infer that إلى الله shifts refuge from lateral relocation to transferred ultimate reliance. A live alternative is that the totalization serves urgency alone and leaves physical flight imagery intact.

changed_reading.before: Find a safer place outside the danger zone.
changed_reading.after: No merely lateral shelter answers an all-reaching field; flee by transferring ultimate refuge to Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: A granted interval of use is followed by arrogant refusal, seizure, and inability either to rise or obtain aid. The focus warning therefore marks a live decision window: urgency comes from the coming loss of capacity, not from rhetorical intensity alone.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the action that remains possible inside the warning interval.
Alarm that awakens caution supplies the temporal signal to act before capacity closes.
Extended remaining use supplies a temporary reprieve rather than permanent safety.
An appointed span supplies the finite boundary of the available response.
Arrogant refusal of obedience supplies the choice that consumes the reprieve.
Capture supplies the transition from available action to imposed consequence.
Capacity and ability, under negation, supply the closed state after warning.
Bodily rising, denied in the scene, supplies the lost possibility of self-recovery.
Aid and vindication, also denied, supply the absence of an external recovery route.

structural_cues: 51:43 gives an until-clause; 51:44-45 then move from refusal to seizure to inability.
The focus imperative follows these completed examples while addressing a still-capable audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reprieve, refusal, capture, and inability; I infer that warning defines the interval in which voluntary flight is still executable. A live alternative is that the sequence illustrates culpability without making temporal agency the focus.

changed_reading.before: The imperative sounds urgent because the speaker uses forceful rhetoric.
changed_reading.after: The imperative is urgent because warning occupies the last interval in which the hearer can still rise and choose a destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Built and expanding heaven, spread and prepared earth, created pairhood, and the summons to remember form a readable environment. The following ف turns that recognition into movement: flight is not disgust with creation but passage from composite, paired signs toward their source.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the transition from reading created signs to reorienting toward their source.
The worshiped One supplies the sourceward destination beyond created pairhood.
Joining parts into a building supplies ordered construction rather than an opaque backdrop.
Concentrated supporting strength supplies the capacity behind the constructed environment.
Expansion against constriction supplies an opening field through which recognition can move.
The non-dominant image of going neglected and directionless supplies a contrast: the focus gives expansion a definite goal.
Spreading and leveling supply an inhabitable, legible ground rather than a rejected evil realm.
Preparing and setting an affair straight supply the world's readiness to function as a sign-bearing route.
Origination supplies the causal relation from created multiplicity back to a source.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the paired structure from which the singular destination stands apart.
Recovery into awareness supplies the cognitive hinge between observing pairhood and obeying the next imperative.

structural_cues: 51:47-49 move from heaven to earth to every created thing, then 51:50 begins with inferentially available ف.
The explicit pair structure immediately precedes a singular named destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, strength, expansion, preparation, pairhood, and remembrance; I infer that the ف of 51:50 converts cosmological recognition into sourceward allegiance. A live alternative is that 51:50 starts a new exhortation and the preceding creation sequence supplies only general warrant.

changed_reading.before: Escape the created world as though material existence itself were the problem.
changed_reading.after: Read the prepared, paired world as a route: move through recognition of its signs toward the One who originates them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the warning formula exactly while prohibiting the placement of another deity alongside Allah. That controlled repetition glosses the goal phrase: flight is the removal of rival coordinates and the concentration of worship on a single destination.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies departure from competing attachments.
Worship and its object supply the singular positive destination.
Causing something to occupy a state supplies the prohibited act of installing a rival coordinate.
The worshiped and what is made worshiped supply the exact field in which exclusivity is demanded.
Otherness beside the first supplies the rival term that the focus destination excludes.
The repeated danger-warning binds the exclusivity gloss to the same urgency as the focus command.
Repeated manifestness makes the prohibition an explicit clarification of the preceding destination.

structural_cues: إني لكم منه نذير مبين is repeated verbatim across 51:50-51.
The first half changes from a positive motion command to a negative prohibition on a co-deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact refrain repetition and the prohibition of another deity; I infer that 51:51 functions as a negative gloss on 51:50's positive direction. A live alternative is that the two commands are coordinated but independently motivated.

changed_reading.before: Seek Allah as one source of safety.
changed_reading.after: Make Allah the exclusive coordinate of worship by leaving every installed rival; the next ayah specifies what the flight leaves behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same sorcerer-or-madman dismissal recurs across separated peoples, then is exposed as if mutually transmitted and rooted in boundary-breaking. In that setting, flight also becomes an epistemic and social exit from inherited labeling toward a warning that discloses meaning and a reminder that can be received in settled trust.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies departure from a socially reproduced interpretive posture.
Meaning disclosed by speech supplies the epistemic destination opposed to dismissive labels.
Messenger and message supply the repeatedly misclassified object.
Diversion and deception supply one stock label used to neutralize disclosure.
Covered reason supplies the second stock label and its claim that the message lacks intelligibility.
Mutually transmitting counsel supplies the image of a dismissal reproduced across communities.
Exceeding the boundary in rebellion supplies the deeper continuity beneath the repeated labels.
The alternate mapped root likewise supplies boundary transgression, preserving the split root's convergent contribution.
Reminder as what reawakens supplies the counter-practice to inherited dismissal.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the receptive condition in which reminder becomes useful.

structural_cues: The exact sorcerer-or-madman pair appears in both 51:39 and 51:52.
51:53 asks whether the communities transmitted the formula, then substitutes shared transgression as the explanation.
51:54-55 move from turning away from the hardened group to continuing reminder for receptive hearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent labels, the question of mutual counsel, transgression, and beneficial reminder; I infer that flight includes exit from a socially inherited reading habit. A live alternative is that the recurrence proves prophetic continuity but does not define the object of فرار.

changed_reading.before: The hearer must move away from punishment as an isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: The hearer must also leave a transhistorical social script that renames disclosure as sorcery or madness and move toward receptive clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is ordered to worship, but the Creator disclaims any need for provision or feeding and is named the strong, firm Provider. Flight toward Allah therefore leaves a transactional deity-model: it is movement into dependent service of the source who supplies rather than needs support.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies departure from a reciprocal bargain model of worship.
Worship and its object supply the destination whose relation is clarified downstream.
Origination supplies the asymmetry between created servants and their source.
Submissive worship supplies the positive mode of life reached by the flight.
An allotted gift, explicitly not sought from creatures, supplies the rejected payment model.
Feeding another, explicitly disclaimed, supplies the rejected idea that worship sustains God.
The named worshiped One identifies the same destination as the independently sufficient Provider.
Allotted giving supplies the direction of provision from destination to fugitive, not the reverse.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies independence from creaturely reinforcement.
Extended firmness supplies stable sufficiency at the destination.

structural_cues: 51:56 states creaturely purpose; 51:57 negates divine need; 51:58 positively names provision, strength, and firmness.
The repeated من in the focus warning and the provision denial keeps source relations prominent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship-purpose, denied divine need, and divine provision and strength; I infer that flight removes a reciprocal-support model and establishes asymmetric dependence. A live alternative is that these verses define worship and providence without revising the motion metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Move toward a deity whose favor must be secured by supplying religious payment.
changed_reading.after: Leave that transactional model and enter worshipful dependence on the Provider who needs neither sustenance nor reinforcement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root inventory itself contains foolish hurry, yet the command's ordinary flight branch demands prompt action. Downstream, wrongdoers receive a matching share with their companions and are told not to hasten the severe day. The juxtaposition distinguishes timely reorientation from impulsively demanding that consequence accelerate.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the valid prompt action required by the warning.
Light, foolish hurry supplies an internal caution against equating urgency with impulsiveness.
Warning supplies the reasoned timing signal that differentiates promptness from rash acceleration.
An allotted share supplies the measured consequence that does not need human acceleration.
Matching likeness supplies the patterned correspondence between present wrongdoers and predecessors.
Companionship and association supply the social continuity by which a matching share is inherited.
Acceleration and bringing forward, under prohibition, supply the explicit limit on rash urgency.
Blocking the truth supplies the settled posture whose consequence is not to be summoned early.
A severe event-day supplies the fixed horizon toward which reckless hastening points.

structural_cues: 51:50 commands immediate-seeming movement, while 51:59 explicitly prohibits hastening.
The matching share and severe day make consequence measured and scheduled rather than produced by the hearer's urgency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hurry branch within فرر, an explicit hastening prohibition, and a measured matching share; I infer a contrast between timely conversion and rash acceleration. A live alternative is that the prohibition concerns only mockery of judgment and does not qualify the imperative's manner.

changed_reading.before: Fleeing well means maximizing speed and emotional intensity.
changed_reading.after: Respond promptly to warning, but do not confuse decisive reorientation with the foolish haste that tries to pull consequence forward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rational recovery after slackening is a rare branch far from the ordinary imperative sense of فرر. It remains anchored in the focus root and is sharpened by the repeated context label مجنون against مبين; downstream prose should present it as an inverse resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ففروا through the rational-recovery branch of ف ر ر, held against مبين.

activation_trace.role: Becoming rational after slackening supplies a second-order sense of flight as recovered judgment.
Manifest appearance supplies the clarity into which recovered judgment opens.
Reason covered by madness supplies the first contextual inverse of rational recovery.
The repeated madness label turns covered reason into a transhistorical foil for the focus command.

changed_reading.before: The imperative concerns only outward escape from danger.
changed_reading.after: It may also activate recovery of judgment from lax or covered reason, moving into manifest clarity toward Allah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the return-to-beginning branch of فرر is form-distant from ordinary flight. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains a coherent origin-purpose path from creation, remembrance, and worship; downstream prose should call it an etymological activation rather than make رجوع the verse's direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ففروا through the branch in which an affair returns to its beginning, with إلى الله naming the terminus.

activation_trace.role: An affair returning to its beginning supplies flight as restoration to an originary orientation.
The worshiped One supplies the originward terminus rather than a merely backward motion.
Origination supplies the beginning to which the rare flight branch can point.
Recovering what was forgotten supplies the cognitive mode of return.
Submissive worship supplies the restored purpose toward which origin-return moves.

changed_reading.before: Flight means increasing distance from what threatens.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, flight may paradoxically be return: recover the created purpose of worship by moving back toward the originating relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because exposure, search, and drawing out inner speech invert the concealment expected from flight. It remains anchored in a supplied ف ر ر branch and coheres with مبين as meaning-disclosure and the context's contrast between covered reason and reminder; downstream prose should frame it as a paradoxical search-image, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ففروا through the exposing and searching branch of ف ر ر, joined to مبين as disclosed meaning.

activation_trace.role: Exposure, investigation, and drawing out what is within supply a paradoxical inward-search dimension to flight.
Revealing meaning by speech or sign supplies the disclosed result of the search.
What is hidden in the breast supplies the interior that the exposing branch can draw into the open.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the operation that brings latent recognition forward.

changed_reading.before: Flight protects the self by withdrawing and concealing it.
changed_reading.after: A live branch resonance makes flight toward Allah an exposing search in which warning and reminder draw concealed recognition into clarity.

strongest_changes: The historical sequence turns generic refuge into a reversal of Pharaoh's reliance and a choice of destination before capture imposes one.
The warning defines a finite agency window: after refusal, neither rising nor aid remains available.
The creation sequence makes flight a sourceward reading of prepared, paired signs, and 51:51 makes that destination exclusive.
51:56-58 removes a transactional deity-model, while 51:59 distinguishes prompt reorientation from reckless hastening.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserved voluntary versus forced movement, the route from paired creation to its source, and the rare return, rational-recovery, and exposure branches of ف ر ر instead of collapsing the ayah into generic fear or piety.
remaining_uncertainties: The inferential force assigned to the initial ف in 51:50 may be weaker than the creation-to-Creator model requires.
The vector parallels with Pharaoh and the agency contrast with forced throwing are reader-supplied arrows, not explicit equations in the packet.
The rare ف ر ر outliers are branch resonances and should not displace the ordinary escape sense.
The social-label model may describe the warning's reception more directly than the commanded flight itself.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Flight is redirected toward the only secure destination.** `ف ر ر/B001` supplies flight/escape; `ء ل ه/B002` the fixed divine name; `ن ذ ر/B001` warning that awakens caution; `ب ي ن/B004` clarity. The preceding ruins show flight from harm, but *ilā* supplies a positive target. I infer **clear warning -> danger recognized -> escape toward divine protection**. The verse converts fear into directed movement.
2. **Flight uncovers what warning probes.** `ف ر ر/B002` supplies probing and drawing out what is hidden, while `ب ي ن/B005` supplies disclosed meaning. Exploratorily, I infer **warning examines attachments -> false refuges exposed -> movement toward God**. This inward diagnostic reading coexists with urgent escape.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:58 clarified why the destination is secure: the fixed divine name is followed by the self-sufficient Provider of integrated strength, not a refuge needing support.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Escape becomes return to the sustaining origin.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ف ر ر/B001` is “flight and escape,” while `B003` supplies the selected latent image “returning to the beginning”; fixed `ء ل ه/B001` is worship and the worshipped one; fixed `ن ذ ر/B001` is a warning that awakens caution; fixed `ب ي ن/B005` is disclosing meaning by expression. **Structural cue:** failed rising, strong sky-building, prepared earth, and proportioned pairs occupy 51:45–49; exclusive worship, inherited rejection, overflow, withdrawal, and renewed reminder follow in 51:51–55. **Role and abduction:** flight supplies urgency, return supplies destination, and clear warning discloses the route; I infer that one escapes the collapsing orders just surveyed by moving toward their sustaining source. **Reading change:** the paradoxical command is neither aimless panic nor mere retreat; it is accelerated reorientation back to origin.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:51–55 clarified return by contrast: rival construction splits direction, inherited labels resist it, and renewed reminder keeps reopening the route for receptive hearers.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü bir kuş olarak tanımlar ve daha özel kayıtta küçük bir serçe olduğunu belirtir. Dal çerçevesi genel ve özel tanımları doğru biçimde sıralar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal küçük bir kuş adıdır; hayvan yavrusu veya aynı ses biçimindeki ağaç ve binek anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kuş adını korur ve kaynakların genel kuş ile küçük serçe arasındaki özgüllük farkını belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kaynakta genel olarak kuş, diğerinde küçük bir serçe olarak tanımlanan küçük kuş adı.

facets.statement: Söz bir kuşu adlandırır.
Daha özel kaynak açıklaması kuşu küçük bir serçe olarak sınırlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kuş kimliğinde birleşir; toplu kayıt bunlardan birinin daha özel biçimde küçük serçe açıklaması verdiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel kuş kaydıyla daha özel küçük serçe açıklamasını birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuş kimliğini ve küçük serçe biçimindeki özel açıklamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynak açıklamasının kuşu özellikle küçük bir serçe olarak belirlediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun türsel ve boyutsal özel açıklamasını açık biçimde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: küçük bir kuş veya küçük serçe

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir kaynakta küçük serçe olarak açıklanır, ancak diğer kayıtta yalnızca genel kuş kimliği verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuşun serçeden de küçük olduğunu belirten daha kesin bir boyut karşılaştırması taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da serçe çevresinde tanımlanan çok küçük bir kuş adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal küçük serçeyle özdeşleştirilebilir veya genel bırakılabilir; komşu dal ise kuşu serçeden daha küçük ayrı bir kuş olarak sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal küçük bir kuş veya küçük serçe için kullanılan addır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yabani ya da evcil güvercin türleri ve renkleri konusunda değişen daha geniş bir kuş grubunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sözlükleşmiş bir kuş adını ve kaynaklar arasında değişebilen tür açıklamasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Türsel gönderimleri ayrıdır: odak dal küçük serçe çevresindedir, komşu dal güvercin türleri çevresindedir ve birbirlerinin yerine kullanılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; boyut bakımından en yakın küçük kuş ile kaynak değişkenliği taşıyan başka kuş adı seçildi, böcek, hayvan sesi ve büyük kuş adayları yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yerdeki ince bir su yolu anlamını doğrudan benimsemek yerine bunu bazı dilcilerin iddiası olarak aktarır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu çekinceyi ve sözlükleşme kapsamının çözülmemiş olduğunu açıkça taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yerde bulunan ince bir su yolu kaydıyla sınırlıdır ve tek kaynakta dolaylı, çekinceli biçimde aktarılmıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bu kullanımın yalın veya kalıba bağlı olduğunu varsaymaz; yalnızca çekinceli tek kayıttaki ince su yolu açıklamasını verir.

concept_map.definition: Bazı eski dilcilerin görüşü olarak aktarılan, toprağın içinde uzanan ince bir su yolu veya dar kanal.

facets.statement: Gönderim, toprağın içinde uzanan ince ve dar bir su yoludur.
Kayıt doğrudan doğrulama değil, bazı eski dilcilerin görüşünü çekinceyle aktarma biçimindedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kayıt, toprağın içindeki ince su yolu açıklamasını kesin bir ortak kullanım olarak değil, bazı dilcilerden aktarılan çekinceli bir görüş olarak sunar.

source_details.summary: İnce su yolu anlamı yalnızca bu kayıtta ve bazı dilcilerin görüşü olduğu belirtilerek aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca çekinceli tek kaynak kaydındaki dar su yolu açıklamasını temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Toprak içindeki ince ve dar su yolu gönderimini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kayıttaki ince su yolunun fiziksel biçimini açıklamak gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun geçtiği ince ve dar toprak kanalını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özellikle ince ve dar bir su yoludur ve varlığı çekinceli tek kayda dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taşan veya bol suyun aktığı genel akarsu yatağını, toprağı yarma ve suyun akma eylemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal toprağın içinden suyun geçtiği doğal veya açılmış bir akış yolunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal su miktarı ve akış eylemi bakımından geniş bir akarsu kavramıdır; odak dal yalnızca ince bir kanal görünümünde ve çekinceli kaydedilmiştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca toprağın içindeki ince su yolunun adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal suyu havuza yönelten kanalın yanında akışı kolaylaştırma, yön verme ve engelleme işlemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da suyun belirli bir yatak veya kanal boyunca ilerlemesi söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal fiziksel olarak ince bir su yolunu adlandırır; komşu dal kanalın hedefini ve su akışını yönetmeye ilişkin eylemleri de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel akarsu yatağı ile yönlendirilmiş dar kanal en açıklayıcı sınırları verdi, özel yer adı, su birikintisi ve akarsu ağzı adayları yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kadınlara ilişkin bu sözü başka bir eski nitelemeyle eşitler, fakat o nitelemenin anlamını kendi içinde açıklamaz. Bu nedenle dal ayrı tutulabilir, ancak iffete veya erkeklerden kaçınmaya ilişkin daha ayrıntılı yorum kaynak ifadesinin kesin içeriği gibi sunulamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadınlar için kullanılan eski ve anlamı kaynakta tam açılmayan bir nitelemeyle sınırlıdır; kesin davranışsal özellik ayrıca kanıtlanmamıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kullanımın yalın mı yoksa belirli bir yapıya mı bağlı olduğunu varsaymaz ve açıklanmayan eski eşdeğerin ötesinde kesin bir özellik yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Kadınlar için kullanılan ve kaynakta anlamı açıklanmadan başka bir eski kadın nitelemesiyle karşılanan bir sıfat.

facets.statement: Söz kadınları niteleyen eski bir sıfat olarak kaydedilir.
Kaynak açıklaması yalnızca başka bir eski nitelemeye gönderme yapar ve davranışsal içeriği açıkça tanımlamaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kayıt kadınlara özgü eski bir nitelemeyi başka bir eski sözle açıklar; gönderme yapılan sözün anlamını ayrıca tanımlamadığı için daha özel yorum belirsiz kalır.

source_details.summary: Kadınlara yönelik bu eski niteleme yalnızca tek kaynakta ve anlamı ayrıca açılmayan bir eşdeğerle kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynağın kesin olarak verdiği kadınlara özgü sıfat işlevini korur ve belirsiz özelliği uydurmaz.

error_profile.preserves: Kadınlara uygulanan eski bir niteleme olma bilgisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin kesin davranışsal içeriğinin belirlenemediği sözlük açıklamalarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözün kadınlara yönelik eski sıfat işlevini ihtiyatlı biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kadınlara yönelik eski bir sıfatı yalnızca açıklanmamış bir eşdeğer üzerinden kaydeder.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çirkin davranıştan veya erkeklerden uzak duran iffetli kadını ve ayrıca ürkek hayvanları açıkça tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kaynaklarda kadınlara uygulanan yakın eski nitelemeler çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal uzak durma ve iffet içeriğini açıkça verir; odak dalda ise bu ayrıntı doğrudan açıklanmadığından aynı anlam kesin biçimde kurulamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; kaynakta gönderme yapılan nitelemeyi anlamlandırmaya en yakın tek komşu seçildi, iffet, utanmazlık ve kişilik alanındaki diğer adaylar doğrudan kanıt sağlamadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün belirli bir Arap topluluğunun alt kolunun adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir ve iki kayıt topluluğun daha geniş bağlılığını farklı ayrıntı düzeylerinde verir. Dal özel topluluk kimliğini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel bir eylem veya nitelik değil, belirli bir soy topluluğunun alt koluna verilen addır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca belirli topluluk adının oluşturduğu sözlüksel birime bağlıdır ve parçalarından genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kaynaklarda belirli bir büyük topluluğa bağlı olduğu veya genel olarak Araplar arasında bulunduğu belirtilen bir soy topluluğu alt kolunun adı.

facets.statement: Söz belirli bir soy topluluğunun alt kolunu özel ad olarak gösterir.
Kaynaklardan biri daha geniş topluluğu özel olarak belirtirken diğeri yalnızca Araplar içindeki bir alt kol olduğunu söyler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bunun bir Arap soy topluluğu alt kolunun adı olduğunda birleşir; topluluğun daha geniş bağlılığı bir kayıtta daha özel, diğerinde daha genel verilir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli bir Arap soy topluluğu kolu
concept_gloss.applicability: Özel adı yeniden üretmeden topluluğun türünü ve kaynaklardaki bağlılık düzeyini açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir Arap soy topluluğu alt kolu olma kimliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özel topluluk adının hangi tür soy birimini gösterdiğini açıklayan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun daha büyük bir soy birimine bağlı alt kol niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belirli bir Arap boy kolunun adı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli bir soy topluluğu alt kolunun özel adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir topluluğun soy yapısındaki alt kol türünü genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal büyük bir soy topluluğu içindeki daha küçük alt birim kavramıyla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel kategori adıdır; odak dal ise bu kategoriye giren belirli bir topluluğun özel kimliğidir ve kategori adı yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kendi kaynaklarında belirtilen ayrı bir soy topluluğu kolunun adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başka bir ad taşıyan farklı bir Arap soy topluluğu alt koludur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Araplar içindeki belirli soy topluluğu alt kollarını özel adla gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Topluluk türleri aynıdır, fakat gönderdikleri tarihsel soy grupları farklıdır; adlar birbirinin eşanlamlısı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gevşeklik veya kendini bırakma halinden sonra yeniden akıllı ve ölçülü duruma gelme geçişini açıkça belirtir. Dal çerçevesi yalnızca akıl durumunu değil, önceki halden sonraki toparlanmayı da korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam sürekli akıllılık değil, bir gevşeme ya da çözülme döneminin ardından aklını yeniden başına toplama değişimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın geçiş anlamını verir ve kalıcı akıllılık, ahlaki engelleme veya aklın tümden yitmesi gibi komşu durumları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir gevşeklik veya kendini bırakma halinden sonra aklını başına toplayıp yeniden ölçülü düşünür duruma gelmek.

facets.statement: Başlangıçta gevşeme veya kendini bırakma hali bulunur.
Bu halin ardından kişi yeniden akıllı, ölçülü ve kendini denetler duruma gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kayıt, akıllı olmayı durağan bir nitelik olarak değil, gevşeklikten sonra gerçekleşen zihinsel toparlanma olarak tanımlar.

source_details.summary: Gevşekliğin ardından aklını başına toplama geçişi yalnızca bu kayıtta belgelenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Önceki gevşeme halini ve ardından gelen zihinsel toparlanmayı birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Gevşeklikten ölçülü düşünmeye doğru gerçekleşen geçişi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin önceki dağınık veya gevşek halinden sonra yeniden ölçülü davrandığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durumdan zihinsel denetime geçişi doğal anlatımla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gevşeklik halinden sonra gerçekleşen zihinsel toparlanma geçişini zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalıcı akıllılık, sağlam düşünme ve bir işte başkasını sağlamlaştırma anlamlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aklın yerinde olması, ölçülü düşünme ve davranışı denetleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yerleşik bir nitelik veya sağlamlaştırma eylemidir; odak dal ise önceki gevşeklikten sonra kazanılan yeni durumu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal zihinsel denetimin gevşeklikten sonra yeniden kazanılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal aklın kaybolmasını veya kişinin düşünme yetisini yitirmiş sayılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin akla dayalı düşünme ve kendini denetleme durumundaki değişimi konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Değişim yönleri karşıttır: odak dal aklın yeniden işler hale gelmesine, komşu dal ise aklın ortadan kalkmasına yönelir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam insan topluluğunun birbirine karışmış durumda bulunmasına bağlıdır; genel karıştırma eylemi veya sıcak dönemi anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca insanların karışıklık içinde olduğunu bildiren kayıtlı kalıba bağlı tutulur ve genel bir karışma fiiline genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir söz kalıbında insanların düzenli gruplar halinde ayrılmayıp birbirine karışmış durumda bulunması.

facets.statement: İnsanlar birbirinden ayrık ve düzenli gruplar halinde değil, iç içe geçmiş durumdadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kayıt, insan topluluğunun birbirine karışmış halini belirli bir durum kalıbı içinde verir ve daha genel bir karıştırma işlemi tanımlamaz.

source_details.summary: İnsanların birbirine karışmış durumda bulunmasını anlatan bu kalıp yalnızca tek kaynakta belgelenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kayıtlı insan topluluğu kalıbındaki karışık durumu temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanların ayrışmadan birbirine karışmış bulunması durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun düzenli biçimde ayrışmadığı ve kişilerin iç içe bulunduğu anlatı bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan topluluğunun karışık durumunu doğal bir cümle içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca insanların içinde bulunduğu karışık durumu ve belirli söz kalıbını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yiyecek, soy, hayvan, tahıl ve başka varlıkları karıştırma eylemiyle bunların karışmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ayrı öğelerin sınırlarını yitirerek iç içe geçmesi durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal katılımcı ve işlem bakımından geneldir; odak dal yalnızca insan topluluğunun karışmış halde bulunmasına ve kayıtlı kalıba bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca insanların fiziksel veya toplumsal olarak birbirine karışmış bulunmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iç sıkıntısı, dillerin karışması, topluluğun gürültüsü ve görüş ya da eşyanın dağılması gibi kargaşa belirtilerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insan topluluğunun düzenini yitirip ayrışmasının güçleştiği durumlarda kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal zihinsel ve işitsel kargaşayı da içerir; odak dalda gürültü, kaygı veya dağılma zorunlu değildir, yalnızca insanların iç içe geçmesi yeterlidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.
